text:
Sam: Heads-up: automated integrity check flagged repeated KMS Decrypt denies for mtls-edge-key in eu-west around 04:18 UTC. Seeing TLS alert 40 on a subset of edge proxies.

Iris: I see the same. Sample proxy log: `2026-09-03T04:18:12Z proxy: KMS Decrypt PERMISSION_DENIED principal=svc-edge-eu`. Traffic degraded ~2-3%% for a 6m window.

Tom: Any recent RBAC changes? I didn't touch keystore roles today.

infra-bot: iam-policy-change: PR #1587 merged 2026-09-03T03:55Z by Iris (removed legacy group binding for cloudkms.decrypter).

Iris: That was the change. I intended to remove an old infra group but thought service accounts were explicitly bound. Looks like we lost svc-edge-eu.

Sam: For immediate mitigation can we enable proxy fallback to cached certs only in eu-west and add a short TTL so we don't pile up stale tickets? Flag: `--mtls-cache-ttl=30s`.

deploy-bot: feature-toggle: applied `--mtls-cache-ttl=30s` to eu-west proxy canary at 04:25Z.

Tom: Canary reports handshake failures drop to near-zero and latency impact is +28ms when fallback used. Acceptable while we fix bindings.

security-oncall: Action items: 1) Iris open scoped RBAC revert to re-add explicit binding for svc-edge-eu (ETA 20m). 2) Add a CI smoke that runs `kms.cryptoKeys.decrypt` with affected SAs pre-merge. 3) Dashboard alert on KMS decrypt denies (protoPayload.status.code=7) per key >5/min.

Iris: Opening PR #1589 to restore binding and adding a checklist item. Will request expedited review.

Sam: Audit query we used: `resource.type="kms_crypto_key" AND protoPayload.status.code=7 AND protoPayload.request.name:mtls-edge-key AND protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail:svc-edge-eu` 1shared.

infra-bot: incident-ticket SEC-2026-311 created and linked to PR #1589.

Tom: Long-term: let's maintain a registry file `keystore_consumers.yaml` mapping keys -> required principals by region; gate IAM PRs against that file. Add metric `keystore.decrypt.denies{principal,key}` too.

security-oncall: +1. Also document fallback tradeoffs in runbook (latency, cert churn). After PR verifies, revert the cache-ttl override.

Iris: Sorry for the disruption. Merging PR after pair-review now. Will paste postmortem notes to SEC-2026-311 once verified.

Sam: Thanks all.
